items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So, he’d just get me on these solos to do the stuff and….

ctx.x: Aretha Franklin and Yes and Zeppelin, James Taylor… I mean, it’s just better songwriting – they wrote songs. Now, I mean, songs are produced in computers and they have pitch-correction machines that fix all of the stuff…and, you know?
